newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - HRW yields seen high.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - HRW yields seen high.

text.p: Hard red winter wheat harvest was under way in parts of Montana, and several cash dealers said early yields were coming in about 60 percent above last year's levels.
"We're getting 40 to 60 bushels per acre," a Montana dealer said. "Compared to last year it's probably an increase of about 60 percent."

Another Montana dealer said the spring wheat crop was also looking better than it had in recent weeks, leading some to predict this year's spring and winter wheat crop would be among the largest in state history.

"They're predicting the third largest Montana crop ever," the dealer said. "Prices are probably going to be severely depressed. We're already hearing (farmers) saying they're going to put it away if the price doesn't come up."

Spring and hard red winter wheat bids were mostly lower, tracking movements in MGE and KCBT futures, merchandisers said. Bids firmed at several West Coast locations, due largely to increased export demand from the Pacific Northwest, Washington merchandisers said.
